name: Appenate
description_en:
Appenate is a product in the No-code applications category. Its directory profile covers Application Templates, Integrations Management, App Integrations, Machine Learning, Drag and drop Builder, Workflow Management, Web Development, Version Control.

Additional listed capabilities include Testing Management, Mobile Development, Debugging, Access Control. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Mobile App (Android, iOS) Desktop App (Windows). The listed organization sizes are Large Enterprises Medium Business. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Business Hours, Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Available Starts at $9.9.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: define steps and route work through a process; track changes to files and support revision workflows; organize test cases, execution and results; inspect program execution to investigate faults; restrict information and actions according to permissions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Appenate 属于无代码应用软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括应用模板、集成管理、应用集成、机器学习、拖放构建器、工作流管理、网站开发、版本控制。

资料还列出测试管理、移动应用开发、代码调试、访问控制。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 移动应用 (Android, iOS) 桌面应用 (Windows)。资料所列适用组织规模为大型企业 中型企业。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为工作时间支持, 在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：提供免费试用 起价为 $9.9.。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：定义处理步骤并组织工作流转；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程；组织测试用例、执行过程与结果；检查程序执行过程以定位故障；根据权限限制信息访问和操作。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。

research_gaps.en: Official pricing was read: annual USD rates are $20/$28/$36 per user/month with a five-user minimum; monthly rates differ. The official Help Hub migration notice points to help.appenate.com, which requires sign-in. Deep current documentation for offline synchronization conflicts, permissions, export and recovery was not accessible. Marketing and pricing alone do not establish a completed operating profile.
research_gaps.zh: 已读 Appenate 官方价格：美元年付折算每用户每月 $20／$28／$36，至少五用户，月付价格不同。官方 Help Hub 迁移公告指向 help.appenate.com，该站要求登录。离线同步冲突、权限、导出和恢复的当前深度技术文档不可访问，营销与价格资料不足以完成运行说明。
